RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Neither does appointing another woman rule out bias. Giving a percentage would imply evidence we don’t have.

Your longer experience merits consideration, but digital expertise may legitimately have carried greater weight than years served.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and how your application was assessed against them. Focus on the process, not the panel’s sex. If you uncover sex-related comments, inconsistent criteria, or unequal treatment, consider formal advice. Complaint deadlines and rights to explanations depend on your jurisdiction.
